title: Warm Crispy Kenyan Meat Skewers
description: Savory and indulgent Kenyan dish featuring crispy meat skewers, this recipe is a perfect blend of spices and flavor, whole30-friendly and made with baking powder and air-fry method.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together baking powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the beef, onion, and bell pepper to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the meat and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with coconut oil and place them in the air fryer basket.
Cook the skewers for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through.
Remove the skewers from the air fryer and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
